name: Knott's Baja Taqueria (Fiesta Village) Grilled Fish or Chicken Soft Tacos (No Cabbage Slaw / No Crema Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Baja Taqueria (Fiesta Village · Knott's Berry Farm)

prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Grilled** Fish or Chicken Tacos (not beer-battered fried) with **no cabbage slaw, no pico de gallo, no spicy crema, and no lime squeeze**.
